# Fuente Price Pro

> Intelligent ceiling price and smart allocation platform for dividend investors across US and Brazilian markets (stocks, REITs, FIIs and ETFs).

Fuente Price Pro applies the Bazin ceiling-price method with net-yield adjustments, a cash-flow calendar, and a goal-based smart allocation simulator so dividend investors can reverse-engineer their passive-income targets.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview, ceiling-price search, and product highlights.
- [App](/app): Interactive calculator, watchlist, cash-flow calendar, and smart allocation.
